newsitem.title: CHINA: China's Nanshan Power offers 96 dividend.
newsitem.headline: China's Nanshan Power offers 96 dividend.

text.p: China's Shenzhen Nanshan Power Station Co Ltd said on Friday it would pay a pre-tax cash dividend of 0.30 yuan per share based on 1996 profits.

Holders of the company's hard currency B shares would receive the dividend in Hong Kong dollars at an exchange rate of HK$1.0 to 1.0708 yuan, the company said in a statement in the Shenzhen-based Securities Times.
The registration deadline for both B shares and domestic currency A shares was set at July 30. The shares would go ex-dividend the following day, it said.
The power company posted net profits of 96.02 million yuan in 1996 compared with 50.98 million in 1995 based on international accounting standards.
